_comment: Conversation choices that shape a generic dungeon run, keyed by DungeonTemplate name. 'answer_events' maps a conversation ServerScriptEvent (sent by the client as a campaign sendevent) to points for the room being talked to. 'difficulty_by_points' swaps the room battle's trailing variant word (Tranquil Dream Bear Easy -> Medium/Hard). 'boss_form_by_total' picks the finale scene variant from the run's point total: the first band whose upper bound is >= the total wins. The client data carries no rule; Tranquil Dream's peaceful answers score 1 and lead to Diamond/Ruby Conquest (reported by players), and the five forms follow the colour wheel Conquest (Diamond/Ruby) -> Retribution (Diamond/Blood) -> Cunning (Sapphire/Blood) -> Instinct (Sapphire/Wild) -> Savagery (Ruby/Wild).
